Madagascar is home to some of the world's rarest wildlife, including lemurs found naturally nowhere else on Earth! Today we visit Lemurs' Park near Antananarivo before flying from Madagascar to Seychelles with Emirates.
In this episode of Travelling Mantra, we explore Madagascar's unique wildlife, meet different species of lemurs including the famous ring-tailed lemur, and learn about the island's extraordinary biodiversity.
